proposals.evidence: Andersen's printed pativāsin- 'neighbor' head compares Sanskrit prativāsin- and Pali pativissaka-. His pati preverb head on the same printed page cross-references pativāsin-, and the vāsin- 'living, staying' head on printed p. 169 also cross-references it. The installed pati and vāsin source heads already have accepted rank-1 Turner 8540 and 11605 ancestry, respectively. Preserve the two explicit lexical components rather than treating the whole compound as a reflex of either bare etymon.
